# Construct Model 1: 1.5% migration 

```{r}
create_model <- function(population_size) {
  model_to_run <- coal_model(sample_size=c(0,105,104,104,104,107,107,107,106),loci_number=1000, loci_length=16000)+
    
    feat_mutation(rate=1.25e-8*4*10000*16000) +
    feat_recombination(rate=1.0e-8*4*10000*16000) + 
    #Rate = locus_length * per_generation_per_base_pair_mutation_rate * 4 * Ne
    
    feat_size_change(((population_size)/10000), p="all", time=1/40000) + 
    #Set village pop sizes
    
    feat_size_change((800/10000), p=1, time=1/40000) +                
    #Pop. 1: 'Melanesian' ancestry
    feat_migration(rate=0.015*4*10000,symmetric=TRUE,time=1/40000) + #Set migration rate
    
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=2,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) + #Immediately remove migration from others to Pop 1 
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=3,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=4,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=5,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=6,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=7,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=8,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=9,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=2,time=1/40000) + #Immediately remove migration from Pop 1 to others 
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=3,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=4,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=5,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=6,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=7,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=8,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=9,time=1/40000) +
    
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=3, pop_target = 2) +  #merge all villages into pop 2 at 160 gens
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=4, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=5, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=6, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=7, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=8, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=9, pop_target = 2) +
    
    feat_size_change(((1425/10000)), population=2, time=161/40000) + #Change pop 2 size at 160 gens
    
    feat_migration(rate=0.26*4*10000, pop_from=1,pop_to =2,time = 162/40000) +  #pop 2 receives 26% from 'Melanesian' pop 1
    feat_migration(rate=0.0,pop_from=1,pop_to=2, time = 163/40000) +
    #^^ pulse of admixture from pop 1 to 2
    
    feat_size_change((2050/10000), population=2, time=164/40000) +
    
    feat_pop_merge(time=2002/40000, pop_source=2,pop_target=1) +                #Merge pop 2 into 1 at 2000 gens
    feat_size_change((10500/10000), 1, time = 2002/40000) +                #ancestral pop. size at 2002 gens
 
    sumstat_seg_sites(name = "freq_inland", transformation = inland_segsites_freq) +
    sumstat_seg_sites(name = "freq_coastal", transformation = coastal_segsites_freq)
    
  return(simulate(model_to_run))
}
```

```{r}
# Transformation functions
    inland_segsites_freq <- function(x) {
    lapply(lapply(lapply(lapply(x, as.matrix), head, 417), colSums), function(x) x/417)
    }
    
    coastal_segsites_freq <- function(x) {
    lapply(lapply(lapply(lapply(x, as.matrix), tail, 427), colSums), function(x) x/427)
    }
```


```{r}
#Population sizes 
population_size <- data.frame(Size = c(seq(from = 100, to = 1500, by = 50), 1658, 179))
```

#Run model 1

```{r}
res_model1=apply(X=population_size, FUN = create_model, MARGIN=1)
```

# Construct Model 2: 2.5% migration

```{r}

    feat_size_change(((population_size)/10000), p="all", time=1/40000) +

    #Pop. 1: 'Melanesian' ancestry
    feat_migration(rate=0.025*4*10000,symmetric=TRUE,time=1/40000) +      #Set migration rate
    
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=2,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) + #Immediately remove migration from others to Pop 1

    feat_migration(0,pop_from=8,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=9,pop_to=1,time=1/40000) +
    
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=2,time=1/40000) + #Immediately remove migration from Pop 1 to others 
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=3,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=4,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=5,time=1/40000) +

    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=8,time=1/40000) +
    feat_migration(0,pop_from=1,pop_to=9,time=1/40000) +
    
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=3, pop_target = 2) +  #merge all villages into pop 2 at 160 gens
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=4, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=5, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=6, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=7, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=8, pop_target = 2) +
    feat_pop_merge(time=161/40000,pop_source=9, pop_target = 2) +
    
    feat_size_change(((1425/10000)), population=2, time=161/40000) + #Change pop 2 size at 160 gens
    
    feat_migration(rate=0.26*4*10000, pop_from=1,pop_to =2,time = 162/40000) +  #pop 2 receives 26% from 'Melanesian' pop 1
    feat_migration(rate=0.0,pop_from=1,pop_to=2, time = 163/40000) +
    #^^ pulse of admixture from pop 1 to 2
    
    feat_size_change((2050/10000), population=2, time=164/40000) +
    
    feat_pop_merge(time=2002/40000, pop_source=2,pop_target=1) +                #Merge pop 2 into 1 at 2000 gens
    feat_size_change((10500/10000), 1, time = 2002/40000) +                #ancestral pop. size at 2002 gens

    sumstat_seg_sites(name = "freq_inland", transformation = inland_segsites_freq) +
    sumstat_seg_sites(name = "freq_coastal", transformation = coastal_segsites_freq)
    
  return(simulate(model_to_run))
}
```


# 1.5% model 

```{r}
# Here, sites are filtered based on findings of Satyagraha et al. 2015
# to those with inland_freq > 0.02 & < 0.05, coastal allele frequencies
# for these sites are stored, and the 95th percentile is calculated.

percentile_95_coastal_filtered <- numeric(length(res_model1))

for (run_idx in seq_along(res_model1)) {
  
  # Extract freq_inland and freq_coastal for the current run
  coastal_freq <- res_model1[[run_idx]]$freq_coastal
  inland_freq <- res_model1[[run_idx]]$freq_inland
  
  filtered_coastal_freq_all <- numeric(0)
  
  for (i in seq_along(inland_freq)) {
    # Get inland and coastal allele frequencies for the current locus
    inland_locus <- inland_freq[[i]]
    coastal_locus <- coastal_freq[[i]]
    
    # Filter inland frequencies to keep those between 2% and 5%
    filter_indices <- which(inland_locus >= 0.02 & inland_locus <= 0.05)
    filtered_coastal_freq <- coastal_locus[filter_indices]
    filtered_coastal_freq_all <- c(filtered_coastal_freq_all, filtered_coastal_freq)
  }
  
  # calculate 95th percentile for for this population size run
  if (length(filtered_coastal_freq_all) > 0) {
    percentile_95_coastal_filtered[run_idx] <- quantile(filtered_coastal_freq_all, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    percentile_95_coastal_filtered[run_idx] <- NA  
  }
}


res_model1_freq <- data.frame(size = population_size$Size, 
                                 freq_95 = percentile_95_coastal_filtered)


```

# 2.5% model

```{r}
# Here, sites are filtered based on findings of Satyagraha et al. 2015
# to those with inland_freq > 0.02 & < 0.05, coastal allele frequencies
# for these sites are stored, and the 95th percentile is calculated.

percentile_95_coastal_filtered <- numeric(length(res_model2))

for (run_idx in seq_along(res_model2)) {
  
  # Extract freq_inland and freq_coastal for the current run
  coastal_freq <- res_model2[[run_idx]]$freq_coastal
  inland_freq <- res_model2[[run_idx]]$freq_inland

  filtered_coastal_freq_all <- numeric(0)
  
  for (i in seq_along(inland_freq)) {
    inland_locus <- inland_freq[[i]]
    coastal_locus <- coastal_freq[[i]]
    
    # Filter inland frequencies to keep those between 2% and 5%
    filter_indices <- which(inland_locus >= 0.02 & inland_locus <= 0.05)
    filtered_coastal_freq <- coastal_locus[filter_indices]
    filtered_coastal_freq_all <- c(filtered_coastal_freq_all, filtered_coastal_freq)
  }
  
  # calcualte 95th percentile for this population size run
  if (length(filtered_coastal_freq_all) > 0) {
    percentile_95_coastal_filtered[run_idx] <- quantile(filtered_coastal_freq_all, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    percentile_95_coastal_filtered[run_idx] <- NA  
  }
}


res_model2_freq <- data.frame(size = population_size$Size, 
                                 freq_95 = percentile_95_coastal_filtered)

```

# Plot of 95th percentile against population size: Manuscript Fig2

```{r}

res_model1_freq$type <- "1.5%"
res_model2_freq$type <- "5.5%"


res_model1_freq$point_color <- ifelse(res_model1_freq$size == 1658, "Lansing et al. 2011",
                                  ifelse(res_model1_freq$size == 179, "Cox et al. 2016", "Simulated"))

res_model2_freq$point_color <- ifelse(res_model2_freq$size == 1658, "Lansing et al. 2011",
                                  ifelse(res_model2_freq$size == 179, "Cox et al. 2016", "Simulated"))


ggplot() +
  
  geom_point(data = res_model1_freq, aes(x = size, y = freq_95, color = point_color, shape = type)) +  
      # Vertical lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1658, linetype = "dotted", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 179, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1240, linetype = "dotted", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +  
  
  geom_smooth(data = res_model1_freq, aes(x = size, y = freq_95, linetype = type), method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "darkgrey", size = 0.8) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.105, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +  

  geom_point(data = res_model2_freq, aes(x = size, y = freq_95, color = point_color, shape = type)) +  
  geom_smooth(data = res_model2_freq, aes(x = size, y = freq_95, linetype = type), method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "darkgrey", size = 0.8) +
  
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lansing et al. 2011" = "#009E73", "Cox et al. 2016" = "blue", "Simulated" = "red")) +  
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("5.5%" = 17, "1.5%" = 16)) + 
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("5.5%" = "solid", "1.5%" = "dashed")) +  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Village Effective Population Size", 
       y = "Simulated Coastal Allele Frequency (95th Percentile)", 
       color = "Ne Estimate", 
       shape = "Migration Rate", 
       linetype = "Migration Rate") +
  
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(color = "darkgrey", linetype = "solid", size = 2)
    ),
    linetype = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(color = "darkgrey", shape = c(16, 17))
    ),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )+
    theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1), 
    axis.line = element_blank() 
  )

```


# Site-frequency-spectrum plots


```{r}
percentile_95_coastal_filtered <- numeric(length(res_model1))

for (run_idx in seq_along(res_model1)) {

  coastal_freq <- res_model1[[run_idx]]$freq_coastal
  inland_freq <- res_model1[[run_idx]]$freq_inland
  filtered_coastal_freq_all <- numeric(0)
  
  for (i in seq_along(inland_freq)) {

    inland_locus <- inland_freq[[i]]
    coastal_locus <- coastal_freq[[i]]
    
    # Filter inland frequencies to keep those between 2% and 5%
    filter_indices <- which(inland_locus >= 0.02 & inland_locus <= 0.05)
    
    filtered_coastal_freq <- coastal_locus[filter_indices]

    filtered_coastal_freq_all <- c(filtered_coastal_freq_all, filtered_coastal_freq)
  }

}


plt1 <- ggplot(data.frame(freq = filtered_coastal_freq_all), aes(x = freq)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = viridis(1, begin = 0.5, end = 0.5), color = NA) +
  labs(x = "Coastal derived allele frequency (migration rate 1.5%)",
       y = "SNP Count") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.15, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.15, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = .1,fill = "red")+
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1), 
    axis.line = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

```
